text:
Evan: quick life update — promoted to Principal Engineer last week and got married on Saturday! :tada: photos incoming. would love to do a tiny office happy hour next Wednesday 5pm if folks are around.
Jess: WHAT!!! huge congrats on both. wed pics or it didn’t happen :grin:. next wed 5pm works for me.
Omar: massive congrats evan! wed pics pls. also can we do a non-alcoholic option for the happy hour?
Evan: thanks y'all. here are two pics from the ceremony: https://imgur.com/a/evanweds (nsfw-free). backyard ceremony, super small.
Lina: absolutely beautiful photos!! congrats again 60a. i can bring sparkling water + mocktail mix.
Sam: congrats congrats. i can swing by with a charcuterie board (meat+vegan). card sign-up: https://forms.gle/sign-evan (short).
pyro-bot: Event proposal: "Evan: promo + wedding happy hour" Wed 5:00 PM  Office Lounge. React with :thumbsup: to join or :x: to opt out.
Aria: :thumbsup: count me in. Evan, do you want us to say anything at the get-together? short toast?
Evan: a short toast would be lovely but zero pressure. also, if anyone wants to chip in for a small gift, sam's form is easiest.
Tom: congrats evan!! also question: is it OK to bring a cake or do we prefer finger food?
Jess: cake > finger food for me, but charcuterie also solid.
Omar: i vote portable mini cupcakes so no cutting required.
Lina: putting down a vote for cupcakes + a small gluten-free option (i'm happy to bring gf cupcakes).
Sam: i’ll mark the RSVP in the pyro-bot invite and update the form with contributions.
Evan: you all are too kind. really appreciate this. if any remote folks want to drop a short video message, dm me and i’ll queue them up. see you wednesday!
Jess: sending confetti GIFs :confetti_ball: :tada:
pyro-bot: Event created: "Evan: promo + wedding happy hour" Wed 5:00 PM 2d Office Lounge. Invites sent to team@redwood.com
Tom: adding calendar now. congrats again
_meta: Slack thread: watercooler congrats for promotion + wedding, planning small office celebration, RSVP links, photos, bot-created event
